bias.zh: 回调 · 跌破 100 日和 200 日均线

read.en: Meta fell 2.0% on Nov 11 to $628.77, trading $628.02–648.45 on light volume (0.63x the 20-day average). It is above the rising 5-day ($625.4) and the 10-day ($622.4) and below the 200-day ($631.5), rising 100-day ($635.5) and 30-day ($675.4). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 11, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($587.56), and RSI is 43.4.
read.zh: Meta 11月11日下跌 2.0%，收于 $628.77，盘中区间 $628.02–648.45，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.63 倍）。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$625.4）和 10 日均线（$622.4）上方，200 日（$631.5）、上行的 100 日（$635.5）和 30 日均线（$675.4）下方。MACD 于 11月11日上穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$587.56），RSI 为 43.4。

read.en: The $648.45 high stopped again in the $643–648.5 band, and the close lost the 100 and 200-day and the $630 Nov 9 low, now resistance. Resistance is $630–635.5, then $643.1–648.5 (Nov 4, 9, 10 and 11 highs) and $675.4–681.1 (30-day, Oct 22 high). Support is $621–625.4 (5 and 10-day, Nov 3 close and high), then $606.4–610.1 and $583.8–587.6 (SAR). A close above $635.5 would target $643–648; below $621, $606–610.
